state_boundaries.processing: Select Nigeria ADM1 records; preserve source geometry; write UTF-8 WGS 84 shapefile.

senatorial_districts.source_name: OCHA Nigeria Common Operational Dataset for Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB), version v01
senatorial_districts.official_license: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
source_organizations: Office for the Surveyor General of the Federation of Nigeria (OSGOF)
senatorial_districts.mirror_license: No repository license declared; the underlying COD-AB source is used under its official CC BY-IGO terms
senatorial_districts.verification_note: Feature count, WGS 84 CRS, layer fields, version, and valid-on date match OCHA COD-AB metadata. Direct HDX binary access was unavailable, so byte-for-byte identity with the official archive was not verified.
senatorial_districts.processing: Preserve source polygon geometries; expose source attributes with Shapefile-safe field names.

lga_boundaries.processing: Convert the source GeoJSON polygons to Shapefile; do not clip, snap, or repair source geometry.

river_lines.source_name: NGSA Geological Map of Nigeria 1:2M vector rivers (extracted from PDF layer 'Rivers')
river_lines.source_file: shapefiles/rivers.shp (1054 polylines, every river stroke as drawn, len_km per feature)
river_lines.license: Derived from NGSA map, same as geology units
river_lines.processing: Re-chained fragmented dashes where needed (n_frag), preserved stroke/width, written as EPSG:4326. Includes every small headwater stroke, not just major rivers.
river_lines.validation: All 1054 geometries valid, total length 40198 km, bounds 2.19,3.74,14.65,13.84

road_lines.official_license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY), as listed on HDX
road_lines.source_attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors and other partners; OCHA Nigeria contributor
road_lines.verification_note: The mirror shapefile schema, 4,708-record count, and bounding box match HDX resource metadata; exact archive bytes were not hash-compared.
road_lines.processing: Retain source line geometry and attributes; add UTF-8 character encoding sidecar.

rail_lines.source_name: OpenStreetMap railway export created with OEX
rail_lines.processing: Extract railway line features only; exclude station points and railway polygons; retain source line attributes.

state_capitals.processing: Use state/capital names and two-letter state codes from the MIT list; match one unique GeoNames place by normalized capital name and GeoNames admin1 code; use GeoNames coordinates.

towns.source_description: Package describes cities with population above 1,000 or administrative seats down to PPLA3; it provides no population or feature-code field and is not an exhaustive towns gazetteer.
towns.processing: Filter records to country=NG, retain all 927 records, attach GeoNames admin1/admin2 names where available, and flag fixed-reference coverage with IN_REF.

populated_places.source_name: SafeSignal-Geo Nigeria gazetteer v0.2.0; selected records classified as settlement
populated_places.repository_access_note: The GitHub repository advertised by PyPI returned HTTP 404 through the GitHub API during this build; provenance is pinned to the published PyPI wheel and the embedded CSV's per-row OSM source/license fields.
populated_places.selection: type == 'settlement'; all 22,004 selected rows also have license == 'ODbL' and source IDs beginning with 'osm:'.
populated_places.source_attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; SafeSignal-Geo / Abraham Esandayinze Tanta, v0.2.0.
populated_places.license: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL 1.0) for the selected OSM-derived records; attribution and share-alike obligations apply. The package code license is Apache-2.0 and is not the data license.
populated_places.package_license_note: Package documentation describes the broader gazetteer data as CC BY 4.0 and identifies OpenStreetMap (ODbL), Wikipedia (CC-BY-SA 4.0), and LAMATA sources. This output includes only rows whose own source and license fields identify OSM and ODbL; no Wikipedia/LAMATA rows are included.
populated_places.source_data_vintage: The package upload date is 2026-05-20; the underlying OSM extract date is not separately stated in the package.
populated_places.source_crs: Source coordinates are decimal-degree lat/lng fields from OSM; treated as WGS 84 and written as EPSG:4326.
populated_places.processing: Extract nigeria_v0.2.csv from the exact PyPI wheel; filter to type=settlement with per-row ODbL and osm: source; preserve all selected rows and source IDs; write Point geometry; add IN_REF=Y/N using covers against the unchanged fixed reference. No PDF or PDF-derived features used.
populated_places.completeness_note: An OSM-derived settlement gazetteer, not an exhaustive or authoritative census; mapped coverage and source admin labels vary. All 652 points outside the fixed Nigeria reference are retained and marked IN_REF=N.

codab_lga_senatorial_crosswalk.license: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
codab_lga_senatorial_crosswalk.processing: Export the COD-AB LGA-to-senatorial-district mapping; intended for OCHA COD-AB identifiers, not a blind name join to GRID3 geometry.

hydrorivers_not_included.reason: The HydroSHEDS v1 license restricts standalone redistribution. This bundle uses a lower-detail Natural Earth river extract instead of packaging HydroRIVERS as a standalone shapefile.

grid3_settlement_names.status: source identified; data not downloaded into this workspace
grid3_settlement_names.attribution: eHealth Africa, Proxy Logics, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL). 2020. Settlement Points in Nigeria. Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development (GRID3). https://grid3.gov.ng/.
grid3_settlement_names.dataset_release_description: Described by GRID3 as released in March 2021.
grid3_settlement_names.download_note: A user-provided time-limited Azure CSV export URL was tested through the available web fetch tool and returned HTTP 500. Its signed query token is not stored. No local GRID3 geometries have been downloaded or validated yet. The converter accepts a local CSV export; the separate Feature Service downloader can run in an environment with access to the ArcGIS host.
grid3_settlement_names.coordinate_output: Point geometry in EPSG:4326; coordinates are not duplicated as attributes.
